audit_result.proof_trace: `register_market` takes no `XOracle` parameter and performs no oracle check; a market can be registered, have assets onboarded with nonzero emode collateral factors, and accept user deposits entirely without a configured price feed. When users later attempt to withdraw, `handle_withdraw → is_obligation_safe → collaterals_usd_non_liquidation` calls `get_price_with_check` for collateral assets and aborts with `oracle_price_not_found_error`, locking depositor funds until the admin subsequently configures the oracle.
audit_result.attack_scenario: Admin (or compromised/mistaken admin) registers a market and configures emode collateral parameters before setting up the Pyth price feed; users deposit into the market and then find their ctokens unwithdrawable because every withdrawal triggers an oracle lookup that aborts on the missing feed entry.

PROP-01b-partial3-asm-003.text: Market cannot be listed without a valid oracle price feed (price > 0).
PROP-01b-partial3-asm-003.assertion: forall supportMarket(m): oracle.getPrice(m) > 0 at listing time
